payload.title: Add qualified distribution and honest channel attribution
payload.goal: Relevant agents can discover the service through a small measurable channel set.
payload.owner_role: OPO dedicated Windows release owner / admitted implementation lane
implementation_steps: Verify the existing OPO X identity and allowed route; keep WHB and other accounts isolated. Choose one initial referral/content experiment and prepare readable announcements that link the exact service.

Qualify GitHub under existing ownership/scoped app, Substack publication or LinkedIn Page only when evidence justifies expansion and supported routes exist; routine authorized account organization does not justify fabricated users or website automation.

Record per-account baseline, date-added channel, follower/end/net counts, gross cross-platform follows, post-defined impressions, consent-aware referrals and received conversations; subscribers/unknown actor types remain separate.
tests: Wrong account/channel/hostname/unsupported route blocks publication while drafts remain ready.
Fixture with two channels and missing impressions reports comparable gross follows, not unique people; missing remains unknown.
Synthetic workers/crawlers and real outside users cannot be merged; X AI reply capability stays disabled without X written approval and consent qualification.

review.identity_requirement: A reviewer other than the implementer records actual identity, model/effort and host; distinct-model review when required by the admitted contract. Self-review does not qualify.
review.source_binding: Review exact Git commit and SHA256 manifest of changed source/assets/config; distinguish Windows CRLF worktree bytes from Git blobs. Any repair invalidates affected prior approval.
review.bounded_repairs: At most two repair/review attempts per candidate within admitted budget; unresolved failure creates one actionable block and leaves independent work eligible.

acceptance: At least one eligible useful distribution route has exact-account delivery/readback or explicit blocked effect with ready content.
Per-channel exposure and qualified agent participation are measured separately from transactions.
payload.rollback: Disable this capability, retain immutable evidence/receipts, restore the last reviewed source/config version and reconcile attempted external effects before any retry.
payload.next_eligible_action: Designated owner matches the proposed scope to current Jira/source and assigns disjoint paths; then perform implementation step 1. External gates block only the named effects.

estimate.assumptions: New planning estimate, not historical estimate or worklog. Reuse accepted returned implementation where its exact source passes this contract. Excludes elapsed observation windows, account waiting and shared SH implementation.
estimate.dependency_risk: Host/provider/account qualification or conflicting release-worker ownership can delay dependent effects; offline work remains eligible.
